title: Got Photo Taken Last Night in Dreamworld
content: So last night in once of my dreams, I was at this giant orientation style spot with all these people. everyone was sitting cross cross applesauce looking forward, when all of a sudden a white man stands up slowly turns around and then takes a flash picture of me really quick with this big boxy ass camera. I was kinda feeling myself bc nobody’s ever done that…but that’s when I became fully conscious of wtf just happened. He was kinda watching me the whole time and idk y’all… Has technology been showing up more and make in your guys’ dreams?
